title: The Beginning of Breaking the Pattern
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to touch the core of truth, a terrifying killing intent swept from the end of the horizon—the Ultimate Chess Player's piece had already landed between his brows.

text.content:
Deep within the Mental Sea, that ancient consciousness surged like a tide, and Chen Ji felt his divine soul being slowly peeled apart by an invisible giant hand. Memory fragments spanning ten thousand years flickered past like a carousel—those seers chosen by the Tianji Record, those pitiful lives reduced to chess pieces, those wretched existences who thought they'd broken their chains only to fall into an even larger cage.

He saw the eyes of Heaven's Mandate.

Those were not eyes, but a vast and boundless ocean of will, devoid of emotion, without good or evil, only the eternally operating rules and calculations. Throughout history, seers in its gaze were nothing more than chess pieces on a board, disposable at any moment.

dialogue.content: "Now you understand?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul echoed in the Mental Sea, carrying a weight never seen before, "The so-called Ultimate Chess Player is merely a wisp of that Will walking in the mortal world. It has schemed for ten thousand years, all to find a perfect vessel—and you, Chen Ji, possess the most suitable conditions."

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling the power boiling in his bloodline. Heavenly Fate was burning; every glimpse of the future accelerated his death. But at this moment, there was no fear in his heart, only a resolve to burn the bridges.

He remembered—the answer the Demonic Path commander awaited was actually a cooperation request after blood resonance. In the ten-thousand-year scheme, the first force to dare rebel against the Heavenly Mandate had already prepared a grand gift for him.

"So this is your plan?" Chen Ji spoke in the Mental Sea, his voice terrifyingly calm, "Make me become the next chosen vessel, then devour that Will at the critical moment?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before sighing: "No, that was its original plan. What I want to teach you is how to overturn the entire chessboard."

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with golden light, and for the first time, the complete version's contents appeared before Chen Ji's eyes—it was a forbidden talisman he had never seen, recording the ultimate method to break the chains.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stared at that talisman, then suddenly laughed. That smile held mockery, release, and a mad light.

"I understand." He slowly opened his eyes, "Breaking the chains requires three things: the backlash force when Heavenly Fate is completely burned, the guidance of the complete Tianji Record, and—a scapegoat willing to bear the first wave of backlash for you."

He turned toward the direction of the Demonic Path military camp, "That Saint is the scapegoat you prepared for me?"

"No." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly softened, "She is your ally, not your sacrifice. The real scapegoat is the 'uncle' in your bloodline who has always wanted to possess your body."

Chen Ji was shaken.

Mo Xiansheng continued: "The extermination of your Chen family back then—do you think whose work was it? The Ultimate Chess Player had long set its sights on your bloodline. It killed your entire family just to make you awaken the Tianji Record in desperation. And that uncle of yours was merely a piece it placed by your side, ready to occupy your body at any moment."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent.

So that was it. So his years of being a "waste," that concealment and scheming, were merely a growth curve already anticipated by the Ultimate Chess Player. It had even arranged for that "dear uncle" to harvest all his fruits at the moment of his triumph.

What a grand handiwork, what deep calculations.

But it had overlooked one thing—Chen Ji was never anyone's chess piece.

choice.prompt: Facing the Ultimate Chess Player's ten-thousand-year scheme, Chen Ji must make a critical choice—how to break this game?

choices.description: Utilize the complete Tianji Record's abilities to complete the breakthrough before the Ultimate Chess Player can react, using his own Heavenly Fate as fuel to forcibly interrupt the chains. Highest risk, but maintains complete independence.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain "Chain Rift" status, can briefly break free from chains for three breaths every two hours
choices.risk_hint: Instant death when Heavenly Fate reaches zero, no turning back

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, formed seals with both hands, and the complete Tianji Record's talisman began burning furiously. He would use his own Heavenly Fate to forcibly burn through the chains, even if it meant destruction.

"Come then." He murmured softly, "Let me see if your ten-thousand-year chess game can withstand my table-flipping move."

text.content:
After weighing his options, Chen Ji made his decision. He raised his hand, and a blood contract talisman flew toward the Demonic Path military camp.

"Since we're flipping the table, let's drag everyone into it." A dangerous arc curved at the corner of his mouth, "Saint, I have a proposal—how about we share the glory of breaking this pattern together?"

choices.description: Do not act rashly, first use the complete Tianji Record to deduce the Ultimate Chess Player's next move, preemptively set up arrangements before it makes its move, exchanging minimal risk for maximum gain. Requires immense patience.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 150 Heavenly Fate points for complete deduction
choices.visible_reward: Obtain "Chess Game Blind Spot" marker, can predict the Ultimate Chess Player's next three moves
choices.risk_hint: During deduction, chain backlash intensifies, consuming an additional 20 Heavenly Fate points per two hours

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly. He sat cross-legged, and the complete Tianji Record unfolded slowly within his Mental Sea.

"Ten-thousand-year chess game..." he murmured to himself, "Then I will use ten-thousand-year patience to solve it. Ultimate Chess Player, since you enjoy playing chess, I will play it with you until the end of time."

Talismans flowed, and the deduction began.

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, a violent tremor rang out from the depths of his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly trembled violently, golden light beginning to溢出 from his outline.

"What have you done?!" For the first time, panic threaded through Mo Xiansheng's voice, "The Ultimate Chess Player's Will... it is reverse-tracking through our connection!"

Chen Ji's pupils constricted. He felt a pressure beyond imagination pouring down from above the heavens, that power was tearing apart the barrier between him and Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content:
"There's no time to explain!" Mo Xiansheng shouted, "Chen Ji, I will buy you time, but you must make a choice immediately—whether to bear the impact of this Will alone, or to establish a contract with that Saint right now!"

All the hairs on Chen Ji's body stood on end. He could feel that Will frantically eroding his Mental Sea; with each passing moment, his divine soul was being stripped away layer by layer.

This was the terror of the Ultimate Chess Player—even a wisp of its fragmentary manifestation was enough to annihilate a mortal's divine soul!

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chess Player's Will is eroding your Mental Sea; Mo Xiansheng can only hold on for another thirty breaths—

choices.description: Immediately send a blood contract request to the Demonic Path Saint, share the impact of this Will through "Shared Destiny." Only her "Demonic Mist" can withstand this Heavenly Mandate Will.
choices.visible_cost: Contract takes effect immediately, fate bound with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Successfully resist Will erosion, gain a breathing space
choices.risk_hint: Contract conditions determined by the Saint, may pay an unexpected price

text.content:
Chen Ji hesitated no longer. A scorching blood light shot from his brow center, piercing through the void directly toward the Demonic Path military camp!

A moment later, a cold demonic aura whistled over, coiling around him. The Demonic Path Saint's cold voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Contract established. From now on, your life is my life."

Black mist spread, and that Heavenly Mandate Will's erosion was truly blocked outside.

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth, allowing that Will to invade his divine soul. Agonizing pain like ten thousand ants gnawing at his brain—he felt his consciousness being stripped away bit by bit.

But he could not fall.

"Mo Xiansheng!" he roared, " unseal me!"

Golden talismans exploded within the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul transformed into streaming light rushing into the depths of his divine soul—unsealing complete!

Just then, the complete Tianji Record suddenly erupted with blinding light—the true content of Chen Tianming's final task finally appeared completely before Chen Ji for the first time.

Those were not characters, but a scene:

In a chaos of void, countless chains wound together to form a massive cocoon. On each chain was engraved a name—the names of seers throughout history, their divine souls eternally imprisoned within, becoming fuel to maintain Heaven's Mandate's operation.

And at the very center of those chains, a rift was slowly expanding.

dialogue.content:
"This is Chen Tianming's final task." Mo Xiansheng's voice became profound and majestic after unsealing, "It is not to make you become the next seer, but—to sever all chains, freeing the imprisoned seers of past generations."

He paused, voice trembling slightly: "Those existences used by the Heavenly Mandate as fuel... they were supposed to be your predecessors, your comrades. And your only task is to end this ten-thousand-year tragedy."

Chen Ji stared at that slowly expanding rift, and suddenly understood something.

text.content:
"That rift..." Chen Ji said deeply, "is the past seers using their residual divine souls to gradually erode the chains. They knew they could not escape, yet they still paved the way for those who came after."

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while before sighing: "Correct. Do you think why each generation of seers perished mysteriously? That was their active choice—they transformed the residual power left after burning themselves completely into blades to tear apart the chains."

Chen Ji's fists slowly clenched. He thought of Chen Nian, of that Heavenly Fate Lock Key taken away by the Holy Sect.

What would happen to her if all the chains were severed?

dialogue.content:
"What happens after severing the chains?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, "What will happen to my sister...?"

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a very long time, so long that Chen Ji thought he wouldn't answer.

"I don't know." He finally spoke, voice carrying rare warmth, "But there is one thing I can tell you—Chen Nian being taken away was not simple imprisonment. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key... is the core component of the chains. She is the embryo the Heavenly Mandate chose to weave new chains."

Chen Ji raised his head abruptly.

"So, severing the chains means—completely destroying Chen Nian?"

choice.prompt: The truth of Chen Tianming's revelation presents a cruel choice: severing the chains means destroying Chen Nian, while preserving Chen Nian means eternal chains—

choices.description: Abandon the plan to sever the chains, instead seek methods that can both save Chen Nian and weaken the Heavenly Mandate. This path is longer, but at least preserves your sister's life.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the "Sever Chains" main quest objective, turn toward hidden side quest
choices.visible_reward: Obtain "Sibling Hearts as One" hidden achievement, unlock Chen Nian exclusive storyline

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, the image of Chen Nian being taken away flickering in his mind. That small figure, crying out "Brother, save me," while he could only watch helplessly.

"I will not abandon her." He opened his eyes, gaze resolute, "If Heaven wants eternal chains, then let them be eternal. But Chen Nian... I will definitely rescue her."

Even if it meant becoming enemies with all of Heaven's Mandate, he would not hesitate.

text.content:
Chen Ji was silent for a very long time.

"The predecessors sacrificed for ten thousand years to create this rift..." he murmured, "I cannot let their deaths be in vain."

His voice was soft, yet carried unquestionable resolve: "Chen Nian... I'm sorry. Brother made a very selfish decision. But I believe those predecessors will give you a better next life."

The complete Tianji Record thundered, and the ceremony to sever the chains officially began!

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed.

"Who said there are only two choices?" He raised his hand, and the complete Tianji Record's talisman began spinning wildly, "Heaven's Mandate's rules are chains, then I will break these rules. The predecessors pried open a rift over ten thousand years—I, Chen Ji, will use this single moment—"

He took a deep breath: "Pry the rift into a gap, and let Chen Nian walk out through that gap!"

This was a path no one had ever walked. Success or failure remained unknown. But he was willing to bet everything to try.

text.content:
The moment Chen Ji made his decision, the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea suddenly trembled violently. The complete version's talismans were no longer simple gold, but began interweaving with seven-colored light—that was the materialization of the past seers' residual wills.

Countless voices rang in his mind: aged sighs, childish cries, defiant roars, relieved laughter. They were souls imprisoned by the chains for ten thousand years, all witnessing this moment.

"Successor..." an aged voice spoke, "You have made your choice."

Chen Ji felt a majestic power pouring into his divine soul. That was the residual left by past seers after burning everything, seeds watered by their lives.

He felt an unprecedented sense of fullness, as if he could tear apart the heavens with a raise of his hand.

But at the same time, he also felt that Will drawing near—the Ultimate Chess Player's piece had been played.

At the end of the horizon, a figure slowly materialized. That was a man in plain white robes, his features too blurred to see, yet the pressure radiating from him made the spiritual energy within a thousand miles tremble.

"Interesting." That figure spoke, voice like great bells and majestic hymns, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache, "The first ant in ten thousand years to dare overturn the chessboard."

Chen Ji stood proudly, facing that figure. Though the gap in strength was like a chasm, his gaze held not a trace of retreat.

"Ant?" he softly repeated, a mocking arc curling at his lips, "Your so-called Heavenly Mandate is merely a thief treating all beings as fuel. I, Chen Ji, today will demand justice from you on behalf of all the world's living creatures!"

As his words fell, seven-colored light shot to the heavens, and the ceremony to sever the chains entered its final stage—

However, at this moment, an accident occurred.

The Heavenly Fate within Chen Ji's body suddenly drained frantically, as if an invisible hand was tearing his soul from within. That was the chains' backlash—the price to sever the chains was far more brutal than he had imagined.

His vision began to blur; his divine soul trembled violently.

"No..." he gritted his teeth, trying to steady himself, "I cannot... fall here!"

But the drain of Heavenly Fate far exceeded his predictions. If he continued, within ten breaths he would be completely depleted—
